en_US.title: Public Wiki Spoiler-Safe Crosslink Label
en_US.website_article:
A spoiler-safe crosslink label is a controlled name for a related article. It can say that two entries share an object mark, a source voice, a scanner downgrade, a custody route, or a proof-order dependency. It must not say that the link proves the final receiver, the protected claimant, the Atlas consequence, or the ending branch.

The label keeps navigation useful without turning the sidebar into a confession. The reader can follow evidence families, but the relation edge stays procedural until the route earns the answer.
en_US.wiki_article: Spoiler-safe crosslink label: a public/wiki relation label that names a safe relation class and hides the exact spoiler relation. It should include visible relation class, held relation class, confidence state, and safe click target. It must not expose final route, claimant, receiver, Atlas consequence, or ending result.
en_US.pda_codex: PDA related-entry label: this link is safe to open because it shares a visible evidence feature. The exact relation is held. Read source voice and confidence before treating the link as proof.
en_US.scanner_entry: Scanner relation tag: safe relation visible. Exact relation held behind proof gate.
en_US.terminal_note: Terminal link note: related entry is visible by safe feature match. Do not infer final relation from the link alone.
en_US.evidence_caption: Crosslink label: safe relation shown, spoiler relation held.
en_US.spoiler_policy: Safe to show visible relation class and safe click target. Hold exact spoiler relation, final receiver, protected claimant, Atlas consequence, legal verdict, and rescue conclusion behind later proof gates.

en_US.title: PDA Related Article Unlock Hint
en_US.website_article:
A related article unlock hint explains a lock without printing the locked answer. The PDA can say that the entry needs a source voice check, a confidence ladder state, a receipt-body comparison, a claimant-safe audit, or a route alias comparison. It must not say the final receiver or route branch that waits behind the lock.

Good hints keep the player moving. They name the safe action, not the spoiler. They also stop the public archive from pretending a missing link is a broken page.
en_US.wiki_article: Related article unlock hint: a label for locked or partially visible evidence links. It should name visible requirement, held proof class, safe preview label, and next-proof target. It must not expose the hidden relation or final outcome.
en_US.pda_codex: PDA unlock hint: related entry held. Check the visible requirement first: source voice, confidence state, receipt body, claimant-safe audit, route alias, or custody route. The locked answer remains protected.
en_US.scanner_entry: Scanner unlock tag: related entry held until safe proof requirement is met.
en_US.terminal_note: Terminal hint note: link is not broken. It is held by proof class. Complete the safe comparison before opening the relation.
en_US.evidence_caption: Related article held: safe requirement visible, protected answer hidden.
en_US.spoiler_policy: Safe to show visible requirement, held proof class, and next-proof target. Hold exact hidden relation, final receiver, protected claimant, Atlas consequence, legal verdict, and rescue conclusion behind later proof gates.

en_US.title: Scanner Relation Edge Suppression Reason
en_US.website_article:
A relation edge suppression reason is the scanner admitting that it saw a possible connection and refused to draw it. The reason may be low field confidence, source voice mismatch, claimant-safe hold, proof escalation, or a route alias conflict. That is different from no relation.

The scanner should name the visible cause and the safe next action. It should not draw a line that turns a cautious hint into a final relation. It should not silently erase the edge either.
en_US.wiki_article: Relation edge suppression reason: a scanner/PDA graph state used when a possible relation is hidden. It should name visible cause, hidden relation class, confidence state, and safe next action. It must not reveal exact hidden relation or final outcome.
en_US.pda_codex: PDA graph note: relation edge suppressed. The scanner has a possible connection, but the field confidence, source voice, claimant hold, route alias, or proof escalation state blocks display. Follow the safe next action.
en_US.scanner_entry: Scanner graph tag: relation edge suppressed. Visible cause available; exact relation held.
en_US.terminal_note: Terminal suppression note: edge not drawn because showing it would outrun proof order. Compare the safe field before accepting relation.
en_US.evidence_caption: Relation edge suppressed: possible connection held by proof boundary.
en_US.spoiler_policy: Safe to show visible cause and safe next action. Hold exact hidden relation, final receiver, protected claimant, Atlas consequence, legal verdict, and rescue conclusion behind later proof gates.
